stem:
Sana connects an LED to a battery with copper wires. The LED has a longer lead and a shorter lead.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Longer lead to the battery positive terminal and shorter lead to the battery negative terminal: the LED glows.
Longer lead to the battery negative terminal and shorter lead to the battery positive terminal: the LED stays off.
The LED glows in both orientations.
Longer lead to the battery negative terminal and shorter lead to the battery positive terminal: the LED glows; the other way round, it stays off.

teacher.key_rationale: An LED allows current in one direction only: longer lead to battery +, shorter to battery −, glows; reversed, stays off. It does not glow both ways, and the reversed wiring does not glow.
